title: CBG BILLS NOTICE JUNE 22 2022
text:
NOTICE
ISSUE OF 14- DAY CENTRAL BANK BILLS
Tender for 14-day Central Bank Bills amounting to D500,000,000 will be issued and
settled tomorrow, Wednesday June 22, 2022. Tender closes at 2.30 p.m.
Given that the Central Bank Bills are not issued on the Security Settlement System (SSS)
yet, completed applications with official signatures and Stamp should be submitted
online at omo@cbg.gm, before 2.30 p.m. on June 22, 2022. Please note that the ceiling
on the CBG bills yield is the weighted average of the 91-day T-bills of June 22, 2022,
auction which is 2.14%.
Copies of the General Conditions and guidelines of Issue and Redemption of the
Securities can be downloaded from the Central Bank Website at www.cbg.gm.
BANKING DEPARTMENT
CENTRAL BANK OF THE GAMBIA
June 21, 2022
NB: Application forms attached
